mixed_execution.stop_rule: Run all sixteen frozen mixed items once, then evaluate 13-of-16 before any TRAIN_LONGER release.

present_again.release_rule: Replay only the local model bound to a gate after three failed cold items in that gate.
present_again.return_rule: Return to an unscored parallel item, then resume the frozen gate without crediting modeled output.

replay_lesson.release_rule: At most once after a complete non-alarm execution fails aggregate mastery.
replay_lesson.stop_rule: After one full replay, finish if mastery passes; otherwise defer and revisit.

train_longer.ordering_rule: Use only the frozen order after the base mixed block; never release TRAIN_MORE reserves here.
train_longer.stop_rule: Stop immediately when independently correct mixed evidence reaches at least 0.8 over the scored mixed attempts used, or after the eighth frozen additional attempt; do not release TRAIN_MORE reserves here.

train_more.release_rule: Only the gate scoring below 3 of 4 cold items may release its own reserve, in listed order, with at most two released items.

picture_book.instructional_kernel: For presentation and practice, reviewed image-bank photographs and drawings show the same four ordinary object kinds in varied styles. The later purpose-made illustrated micro-story begins with one cup, one plate, one spoon, and one bowl visibly separated from four distinct matching positions, develops as the four objects are moved into their matching positions, and resolves with all four visibly distinguished in one completed arrangement. The event is noncanonical, uses no named or recurring participant, scores only the four object-kind distinctions and four bare labels, and conveys every required learner action through frozen nonverbal machine controls rather than added learner-facing language.

story_arc.coherence_test: Every page advances one continuous four-object arrangement and the terminal page resolves it without adding a scored staging concept.
story_arc.initial_state_or_goal: One illustrated cup, one illustrated plate, one illustrated spoon, and one illustrated bowl begin together in a loose cluster beside four equal empty, unmarked display spaces. All four object kinds are fully visible and visually distinct; no owner, food, material, color category, location meaning, or matching silhouette is established.
story_arc.meaningful_development: Across one connected visual sequence, an anonymous hand briefly enters to lift the four illustrated objects one at a time from the cluster and place them into separate equal display spaces. Each moved object remains visibly the same object kind, and its bare label—cup, plate, spoon, or bowl—is locally presented; the changing arrangement makes the sequence develop without making the hand a participant or making placement, order, or matching a scored claim.
story_arc.resolution_or_stopping_state: The anonymous hand is gone, the loose cluster is empty, and the illustrated cup, plate, spoon, and bowl are all simultaneously visible as four distinct ordinary object kinds in the completed four-space arrangement. The event stops at this visually complete distinction; nothing about containment, position, ownership, food, material, color, or silhouette matching is concluded.

operations.prompt: Create one clean 2-column by 3-row children's picture-book storyboard. Across six panels, keep exactly the same blue ceramic cup, yellow round plate, silver spoon, and green ceramic bowl. On an off-white tabletop, show: (1) all four objects clustered beside four empty equal unmarked spaces; (2) an anonymous hand moving the cup to space one; (3) cup placed and hand moving plate to space two; (4) cup and plate placed and hand moving spoon to space three; (5) first three placed and hand moving bowl to space four; (6) no hand and all four objects placed in order cup, plate, spoon, bowl. Gentle modern children's illustration, crisp educational clarity, no text, no extra objects, no people or faces, no food, no ownership, no silhouette-matching cues, no cropped objects.
